label: B25-RX-OBSERVABILITY-BOARD-INTERACTION

authorization.user_statement: 好，我们继续，许可使用Quartus和JTAG来烧写和测试设备。直接使用这个命令行即可读取和交互。
authorization.scope: Exact frozen T-010 SOF volatile FPGA configuration, bounded direct JTAG-UART interaction, and content-addressed golden volatile rollback on functional failure.

terminal.method: first and only ordinary-file RedirectStandardInput terminal immediately after candidate configuration

attempt_v2_ordinary_file_control.interpretation: All eight ordinary-file bytes reached the production bridge, but immediate startup transmission could still have overlapped a full target TX FIFO; delayed direct interaction was required as a positive control.

terminal.method: ssh -tt followed by the user-specified nios2-terminal command; commands entered into the same live terminal only after READY and repeated zero-event RXDBG snapshots

event_transitions.meaning: one RVALID observation, RX seen, last byte 0x3F
two cumulative RVALID observations, RX seen, last byte 0x70
three cumulative RVALID observations, RX seen, last byte 0x64
four cumulative RVALID observations, RX seen, last byte 0x5A

terminal.exit: Ctrl-C stopped only the task-owned nios2-terminal; tool reported exiting due to ^C on host and exit 0.

attempt_v3b_delayed_direct_interaction.functional_result: FAIL; delayed direct interaction excludes startup TX congestion and proves each command byte reaches the bridge, but no CPU-visible command behavior is emitted.

excluded: wrong candidate SOF identity or failed volatile configuration
wrong JTAG cable, device or instance
early command transmission while the target TX FIFO is full
production bridge failure to observe RVALID and the received byte
CPU failure to issue repeated DATA-register reads
controls_and_classification.remaining_fault_domain: The RX DATA response value, response ownership/timing through the PoC/interconnect, core dmem response, load extension/writeback, or the firmware compare/branch path.
controls_and_classification.statement: The bridge sees every delayed byte and the DATA-read counter continues advancing, yet software emits no byte-specific response. A deeper CPU-visible load observability task is required before any RTL fix.

execution_notes.attempt_v1: The custom server exposed the expected device, but quartus_pgm reported Programming hardware cable not detected. No configuration occurred and the owned server was stopped.
execution_notes.attempt_v3_preflight_failure: A first attempt-v3 wrapper tried to hash a live jtagserver log and failed before quartus_pgm. Owned PID 3920 was stopped and board state remained golden.
execution_notes.evidence_schema_note: The candidate program-result server field contains PowerShell Write-Output strings mixed with the returned server record. Independent programmer logs, PIDs, cleanup checks and postflight bind the functional facts; no board rerun was performed only to normalize this field.

blocker: The production bridge observes all delayed command bytes while the CPU repeatedly reads the DATA register, but status, PONG, diagnostic response and printable echo remain absent.
next: Register a CPU-visible RX load observability task. Trace bridge response, PoC response, core dmem response and committed load/writeback in simulation first; only then rebuild and repeat one bounded volatile board test.
